name: 11852-batchdecode-8b-8gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16, ~16 GB of weights, present in the local HF cache.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 of one node.
parallelism: PP=4 x TP=2 over eight GPUs of one node. No DP, no EP, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 8.2B dense bf16, 36 layers, GQA 32 query / 8 KV heads at head_dim 128; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 384 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: ~950 prompt tokens in and ~950 out, each drawn over [900, 1000], at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos true.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant for 8-billion-parameter drafting, serving 64 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
pp-size: 4
tp-size: 2
disable-radix-cache: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Part of the operating point, not a tuning knob: it caps the resident population at 20 while
# 64 streams are offered.
max-running-requests: 20

error.text: both versions' own code requires the optional mooncake package at start-up and exits before serving
